text.name: info1
text.text: DICE, the Discrete Integrated Circuit Emulator, simulates early 1970s arcade games built from logic chips without a processor, such as Pong.

text.name: info1
text.text: DICE (Discrete Integrated Circuit Emulator) simula os primeiros jogos de arcade dos anos 70, feitos com circuitos lógicos sem processador, como Pong.
